🚀 Caelum Novum – Exploring Beyond Boundaries

We are Caelum Novum, a multidisciplinary team bringing together mathematics, programming, machine learning, and curiosity to tackle challenges inspired by space and science.

Our team combines analytical thinking, software development, AI-driven problem-solving, and fresh perspectives. With a mathematician, a programmer, an ML developer, and an enthusiastic beginner eager to learn and contribute, we believe great ideas emerge when different skills.
